reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: It has really good infrastructure.

review_content.Placements: Placement opportunities are steadily improving year by year. The college has a placement cell that works to bring in companies and provides training in soft skills, aptitude, and interview techniques. Core companies, IT firms, and startups regularly recruit students from AITS.
review_content.Infrastructure: The campus is spacious, with well-equipped laboratories, modern classrooms, and a central library that has a good collection of academic resources. Wi-Fi is available in most areas of the campus, and there are decent hostel facilities for both boys and girls.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Satisfied with faculty, and no placements happened during previous year, and good infrastructure.

review_content.Placements: There are no placements for mechanical department, and no companies can hire us. There is no package that can be provided by placements, if it happens, 2 LPA is enough. Maximum, there is no person who can get an internship in college. No company can come for hiring.
review_content.Infrastructure: There is good infrastructure of college and good facilities and hygienic and good environment. There are good labs and Wi-Fi available, but they can't be switched on for students, they switch on only if Wi-Fi is required for a necessary one. Library is good and food is provided in canteen.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: The college provides poor placements, resources, and limited career opportunities.

review_content.Placements: At the start of 3rd year, they ask to pay the CRT fee for placements. After the placement training period starts regularly, it will affect the semester basis and the CRT lectures cannot teach us properly. They will teach only 3-4 hours in the whole day. At the time of placements, only 3-5 placement selections could be done in the college. All the big companies' placement drives are done in another branch of this college at Rajampet. At that time, the college could not provide any college bus facility to travel there.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is good. Girls have a separate waiting room. It is safe for girls. Purified water is available all over the college. There is no hostel facility in the college. It is out of town and students must travel 2 kilometers to go to the outside hostel near ITI Circle.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Satisfied with faculty and dissatisfied with placements. There is very good infrastructure.

review_content.Placements: There are no placements for the civil department. It is very bad for placements. Companies are not interested in taking students because the in charge can't take seriously about civil students. The strength of the students is very low in the civil department.
review_content.Infrastructure: There are good facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, a library, and sports. There is a good quality food in the canteen. There is no hostel for students. Resources are very good. There is a good environment. The staff is very good. There are very good friends here.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Good placements until 2022. Some of the faculty has no knowledge.

review_content.Placements: Before 2023, there were good placements. From the 2023 batch there were average placements and in our batch some of the students got placed but no boarding, still no response. As for now, our juniors, some students got placed but need to wait and see if they will get onboarded or not.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good with classes, labs, e-rooms and gyms. Everything and sports are also available. PT Sir is very supportive. Athelets can shine. And some events may have been conducted before but because of self-discipline, the events reduced. And women's day happens every year greatly in a good environment.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Good, satisfied about faculty but disappoint about placements and good infrastructure.

review_content.Placements: Thirty percent of students are placed in college placements, and the others are not placed. The companies that approach our college are mainly service-based companies. Students can join internships because the college cannot provide any internships to the companies. The highest package is 6 LPA, and the lowest is 3 LPA. Recruiting companies include IBM, ZITHARA, INFOSYS, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is excellent, and all facilities are available for the course. All equipment should be clean and in good working condition. The quality of food is good, and there are medical facilities available. There will be a better atmosphere for sports and cultural activities.
